To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the early time-point measurement of the kidney dose in [177Lu]DotaTate peptide receptor radiotherapy of neuroendocrine tumors can hamper accurate renal dose estimation.
the presence of a fast and slow clearance phase can hamper accurate dosimetry of the kidneys in PRRT, resulting in approximately a 12.4% underestimation.
the early phase of renal clearance of 177Lu-DOTATATE is fast and that the early phase contributes to the total renal uptake of 177Lu.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the fast phase on dosimetry of renal [177Lu] DOTATATE therapy.
the importance of the timing of the first whole body measurement after [177Lu]-DOTATATE administration.
the influence of early measurements on the kidney dose in PRRT with [177Lu]DOTA-TOC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
early planar measurements can be omitted if a dynamic acquisition during the first hour after [177Lu]-DOTATATE injection is performed.
the first whole body image should not be included in the dosimetry analysis.
dynamic planar measurements during the first 60 min after injection are recommended to obtain accurate renal dose estimates.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the first whole body measurement should not be obtained before 3–5 h after injection, but that omitting this measurement will result in an overestimation of the renal dose by 3.1%.
the first dosimetric measurement should be obtained later than three hours p.i. and the second measurement should be obtained at least 5.1 h p.i. in order to reduce the dosimetric uncertainty.
the early phase of kidney clearance should be considered in the dosimetric assessment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
early measurements should be included into the renal dosimetry calculation.
a single exponential decay is not sufficient for accurate dose estimation in the kidneys after peptide receptor radionuclide therapy.
the first dosimetric measurement should be obtained later than the time at which the fast clearance phase is still active.
